text:
maria: Heads-up - dashboard p99 for /v1/generate spiked after this morning's quota/routing tweak. Backend logs show steady latency, no obvious spike.
jake: Saw it. Rollout note said 'prefer-low-latency' but didn't mention sample attribution. Did routing weights change?
alex: deploy-bot recorded policy:update at 1765556500: `policy:update prefer-low-latency -> weight 0.6`
sophia: How are percentiles computed in console? Are we merging per-route tdigest rollups or recomputing from raw rows? If we merge digests, shifts in route contribution can skew p99.
maria: Console merges tdigest shards produced at ingestion, not raw-row recompute. That can cause nonlinear shifts when a route with sparse tdigest but high tail gains weight.
jake: Repro locally: per-route p99s [routeA:450ms, routeB:1800ms], global raw-row p99=520ms, console-merged p99~950ms. So merged digest differs from raw aggregation.
alex: Paste queries? I'll check merge path.
sophia: Repro SQL used:\n```
SELECT route_tag, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
FROM sample_traces
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate'
GROUP BY route_tag;

SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
FROM sample_traces
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate';
```
Observed mismatch between merged tdigest view and raw combined percentile.
maria: Short-term mitigations suggested:
- show per-route p50/p95/p99 next to merged percentile
- add a "percentile provenance" indicator explaining aggregation method (use non-technical phrasing)
- expose per-route raw sample counts in a debug panel + link to recompute exact p99 via SQL
jake: I'll open a PR to add UI elements and tests comparing digest-merge vs raw percentile on synthetic data.
alex: Backend: expose internal endpoint with per-route raw counts and SQL snippet; also add a warning flag when merged vs raw differs >15%.
sophia: I'll draft an alert rule and a support-facing blurb explaining why merged p99 can diverge after routing changes.
maria: Action items: @jake PR for UI + tests, @alex backend endpoint + warning, @sophia alert + doc, I'll notify support post-deploy.
jake: PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4902 - includes screenshots and unit tests.
alex: Reviewing; we'll gate behind feature flag.
sophia: UX note: avoid 'tdigest' for customers; use 'sampled merge' and 'may differ from exact raw percentile'.
maria: Thanks team — follow-up post-deploy note for CSM.
